info.description: AES-encrypted PII for Stage1/QC4 BFF. Run Step 01-25. Step 03 sets encAesKey. Step 11 returns jwtToken.

request.description: Kubernetes liveness probe. Confirms enrollment service pod is running.
Simple API health check. Verifies BFF can reach enrollment API.
Returns RSA public certificate. Client encrypts AES key as encAesKey for PII fields. Plain-text bodies may fail on Stage1/QC4 BFF.
Returns US state codes and names for owner/beneficiary address dropdowns.
Returns country codes and names for beneficiary citizenship fields.
Lists enrollable 529 plans available to the channel.
Plan metadata, funds, branding for selected plan (e.g. hawaii, upromise, okdirect).
CMS content strings for enrollment screens (labels, disclosures).
